class EmailService
  def self.send_report(email, report_file)
    # Generate and email the report
    system("generate_report --output #{report_file}")
    system("mail -s 'Your Report' #{email} < #{report_file}")
  end

  def self.archive_logs(directory)
    `tar -czf logs.tar.gz #{directory}/*.log`
  end
end
